overview: The BoardWalk Inn is a Deluxe resort styled after a 1920s Atlantic seaboard boardwalk, with shops, restaurants and nightlife right outside the door. You can walk to Epcot and Hollywood Studios.
suits: Couples and adults who like evening entertainment, and families who want to walk to two parks.
rooms: Standard rooms sleep four or five. Rooms facing the BoardWalk are lively in the evening, while garden-view rooms are quieter.
pools: Luna Park Pool has a waterslide styled after a vintage wooden coaster.
dining: Flying Fish is the signature seafood restaurant, Trattoria al Forno serves Italian food, and the BoardWalk Deli is good for quick bites. Jellyrolls has dueling pianos in the evening (21 and over).
pros: Walk to Epcot and Hollywood Studios
cons: Buses to Magic Kingdom and Animal Kingdom
tips: Stroll the BoardWalk at night for street performers and lights.
Ask for a quiet room if you're an early sleeper.
bestFor: Couples and anyone who wants to walk to Epcot and Hollywood Studios.
